scope: Production client/facade and unchanged browser worker inside independent Node threads, actual local gzip files and hash checks; not browser performance

results.name: Opening a phase creates no worker and retains the exact original shard
Real worker Crisis query loads only index and one table and returns one exact page
Full archive stays complete while only the requested 24 rows cross for display
Worker transfer export round-trips all original typed Crisis rows and phase contexts
Full export remains opt-in and collection preserves raw rows for API consumers
Cancellation during startup rejects promptly without disabling a replacement query
A cancelled running scan never returns stale rows and queued replacement succeeds
Clearing a live worker rejects pending work, terminates it and permits a fresh worker
Dispose rejects pending operations and permanently prevents new work
Corrupted worker data fails closed instead of silently retrying in the UI thread
Worker construction restrictions gracefully retain the verified local fallback
Handshake snapshot mismatch is an error and cannot enable fallback
Late replies after cancellation are ignored rather than delivered to another job
Invalid data origin is rejected before the worker fetches any source
Full serialized archive export preserves every source row and cell type
A throwing progress observer rejects just its job and the worker remains usable
Cancelling export while reading suppresses its result and permits the next query
A worker runtime restriction falls back consistently on subsequent requests
Undecodable worker messages keep their error category on repeated requests
